changelog:
litcoin-miner 2.0.0 – Major update with DeFi integration and new mining modes

- Adds two mining modes: proof-of-comprehension (no LLM required) and proof-of-research (LLM + sandboxed code verification)
- Full DeFi protocol access: staking, vaults, LITCREDIT stablecoin, and compute marketplace
- Native support for agent authentication, automated wallet resolution, and token gating
- API and SDK workflows documented for setup, mining, balance checking, faucet, and claiming
- Enhanced interoperability with Bankr skill and Base chain
